item.text:
**Diagnosis:** Ubuntu Gost records are stored as `UbuntuAPI` in [gost/ubuntu.go](/app/gost/ubuntu.go:321), but `NewCveContentType("ubuntu")` returns only `Ubuntu` in [models/cvecontents.go](/app/models/cvecontents.go:316). Paths that select one source therefore omit the Gost record.

The fix should add `GetCveContentTypes(family)` with the requested ordered mappings, while preserving `NewCveContentType` for single-source callers. Use the full mapping in `PrimarySrcURLs`, `Cpes`, `References`, and `CweIDs` in [models/cvecontents.go](/app/models/cvecontents.go:61); `Titles` and `Summaries` in [models/vulninfos.go](/app/models/vulninfos.go:392); and both `isCveInfoUpdated` implementations in [detector/util.go](/app/detector/util.go:185) and [reporter/util.go](/app/reporter/util.go:732). `Cvss3Scores` also omits `UbuntuAPI` entirely, and both severity conversion functions need `NEGLIGIBLE` treated as `LOW`.

Existing tests cover Ubuntu OVAL severity and RedHat source links, but do not establish the requested UbuntuAPI behavior. I inspected code and tests only; I did not edit project source or tests or run tests. The remaining uncertainty is how the new multi-source mapping should handle families beyond those specified.
